about: Planner data: for a team power, the last main stage (in order) still inside each damage bracket, and what a power gain buys. Stage recommended power is game data 1.4.002 after the 2026-09-23 easing (record 003, evidence/06-derived/stage-table.json); the table is derived in evidence/07-derived/bracket-reach.json. Brackets: damage kept 55% from 60% of recommended power, 35% from 40%, 15% from 20% (record 003). The user's team is near 2.2G.

from_2_2g.rule_of_thumb: Near 2.2G each +0.2G (about +9%) moves the 35% reach about three to four chapters and the 55% reach about three; the 15% bracket already covers every main stage from 2.0G. 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G (+82%); at 55%, 6.00G.

what_a_step_buys.posted_gain: +10% (2G → 2.2G, dc:77329); free pulls reach 8-3, points past it need paid pulls (dc:76290)
none in team power: one unmeasured claim of ~+20% account total power (dc:76461)
about +1.5% for one 14→15 step at 1.6G (dc:75684, approximate)
none: record 003's pushers say a padded stage preset shows more than the conquest preset, unmeasured

from_2_2g.rift: The Dimensional Rift opens after 328-30 and is a 35% fight at every level against Rift-inflated power (record 003); its own Dimensional Energy is the power source there (curated/power-sources.json, rift_energy).
